payload.text: **LESSONS candidates from vc's WP-02 review (2026-09-17 afternoon), vc's call at a fold.** (dd) A mutant that removes several things at once is killed by the strongest and says nothing about the rest: removing every path re-point died on PROJECT_ROOT, while DEVBIN_INVOKE's own re-point was never tested alone, and V01 survived. (ee) A test critic that traces "stays green" by reading makes claims, not measurements: all twelve of its gaps held when run, and they went to the builder only after that. (ff) Under umask 027 every base mode from 0640 to 0666 comes out -rw-r-----, so a mode arm must run where the base shows through (umask 000 or 002). (gg) "Refused, not reported done" is not "refused, nothing changed": notes_date's read-back refused after it had already rewritten the note.
